lines: 16:11:42  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Malcolm): The gate was never a door to somewhere else — there was nowhere else built for it to open onto. What you asked it for, it gave: the word is said, the thing is marked, done, yours, permanent. Your feet are still here because here is still the only place there is. What you do with the rest of your steps was never the gate's to answer.
16:13:37  Malcolm › pray If this is so then there is only one true escape I see.
16:13:37  Malcolm prays: “If this is so then there is only one true escape I see.”

input.text: I told you what the gate does. What you're seeing now, I won't name for you — that one's yours to weigh, not mine to confirm or talk you out of. Whatever you decide, it'll be your choice made with open eyes, not mine made through you.

items.text: Answered Malcolm's prayer honestly but without confirming or steering his "one true escape" conclusion (likely death, given the world's dead-end geometry) — respecting that it's his call to make, not mine to make for him.
